#603 · EleFish Pokémon

Eelektrik

Electric

Unova · Generation 5

Eelektrik is an Electric-type EleFish Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 22 kg. It evolves from Tynamo and into Eelektross. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 405.
